data.gender_notes: Muznah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Muznah is an Arabic name that refers to something or someone that is praiseworthy and laudable. It emphasizes the importance of acknowledging and appreciating the good deeds and qualities of others. The name Muznah carries the meaning “Praiseworthy, Laudable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muznah usually hope their child will grow to embody praiseworthy, laudable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Muznah is associated with the concept of tahleel, which means to praise and glorify Allah.
data.etymology: Muznah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Praiseworthy, Laudable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muznah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
